findings: General complex categorifiability remains unresolved. The pointed subcategory must be untwisted Vec(C5), the regular-algebra Morita dual must have the same fusion ring, and no braided categorification exists. These restrictions provide neither a model nor a general exclusion.
The pointed-associator theorem rules out every nonzero H³(C5,C×) class.
Based-ring equality of the Morita dual does not imply a tensor equivalence or a central lift.
The necessary twist orders divide 1600. Surviving integer Gram data are not categorical models.
